svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: FORTX topology: an operator and Razorpay reach nginx through Cloudflare; nginx proxies to the FastAPI process on loopback; the API reads and writes PostgreSQL and caches aggregate reads in Redis; a separate worker process leases jobs from PostgreSQL and makes the outbound WhatsApp, Twilio and Razorpay calls that reach the customer, whose payment returns through Razorpay.

g.text: AWS EC2, Ubuntu - two systemd units, both bound to 127.0.0.1
